digest.component_or_area: Jira Family Adapter / Reconciler Mapping Seam
propositions: Rebar hardcodes Jira workflow mappings (status, type, link relations, priority) in multiple files, preventing support for projects with non-analogous workflow concepts without core changes.

A provider-neutral, config-driven mapping seam layered from built-in defaults → config default block → per-project overlay must enable status, type, link-relation, priority, transition, and parent mappings to be declared in rebar.toml.

Non-representable types must be handled by collapse (with rebar-type: label for round-trip safety), skip (whole-ticket exclusion), or fail-closed validation at config load; non-allowed transitions must replay from the core per-ticket STATUS event log and degrade to drift on replay failure.

Non-representable parents must drift with an echo-safe breadcrumb comment naming the nearest represented ancestor's Jira key; required-field create failures must be prevented by per-project create_defaults.
The mapping core must be provider-neutral (no Jira-specific literals) with the schema, merge logic, validation, and capability descriptor in the core and Jira specifics in the adapter only.

Commands suggest-mapping and rebar doctor must interrogate a live Jira target to emit suggested config and detect compat problems, with the current default hardcoded maps preserved byte-for-identical when no overrides are declared.
